paper_id: Sun et al. - 2014 - Energy-Efficient Neighbor Discovery in Mobile Ad Hoc and Wireless Sensor Networks A Survey
title: Energy-Efficient Neighbor Discovery in Mobile Ad Hoc and Wireless Sensor Networks: A Survey
motivation: 电池技术进展缓慢,能耗成为移动自组网和传感器网络应用的瓶颈,idle listening占主导
problem_framing: duty cycle与discovery latency的相互制约,定义为块设计问题,求最小活跃槽集合
key_insight: 尽管原理各异,确定性协议可纳入统一框架分析;随机与确定方法各有适用场景
method_signature: 按四原则分类:随机(Birthday)、超半占用、旋转抵抗交集、互素周期,给出通用框架
evaluation_criteria: duty cycle、discovery latency(含worst-case)、power-latency product,仿真对比CDF
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Quorum仅支持对称运行;asymmetric情形下最优调度规约为NP-complete顶点覆盖问题;无全优方案
evidence_for_taste: crux lies in the power scarcity
trade-off between duty cycle and discovery latency
they are in conflict with one another
deterministic protocols can be incorporated into a generic framework
we argue that this may still be too restrictive
they are fundamentally limited to symmetric networks
thinking_moves: 将多种协议抽象为统一框架下的分类学分析
用概率论(Birthday Paradox)支撑随机方法的平均性能
用Chinese Remainder Theorem严格证明互素周期方法的worst-case bound
从几何直觉(旋转不变交集)推导出块设计约束
通过仿真揭示随机方法在average case优但在tail behavior差
承认不同方法在symmetric vs asymmetric场景下各有优劣,无全优解
